When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.

```suggestion
export function buildEvidenceContextCacheKey(params) {
  const {
    userId,
    topicPath,
    topicId = null,
    sessionId = null,
    limit,
  } = params || {};
```

Fixed in 0e831d54f. The RPC invocation try/catch now handles only thrown execution/network errors; resolved Supabase database errors are checked afterward and retain the same unavailable-code fallback versus fail-closed behavior.
